Comment.Language: For the Commemoration of St. Shenute the Archimandrite:

Text.Language: Hiten nieu,/ n~te peniwt eyouab n~dikeoc: Abba Senou] piar,/mand~rit/c: P[oic arih~mot nan m~pi,w e~bol n~te nennobi.
Through the prayers of our saintly and righteous father, Abba Shenute the Archimandrite O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
بصلوات أبينا القديس البار أنبا شنوده رئيس المتوحدين يارب انعم لنا بمغفرة خطايانا.
